verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own docs say Bitwarden Authenticator can import verification codes from other apps so users can migrate without re-adding each one. Named sources are Google Authenticator (QR code), LastPass Authenticator (JSON export) and 2FAS (.2fas backup file). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that bulk import works, and evidence of the full list of supported source apps beyond the three named.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand

citations.quote: You can import verification codes into Bitwarden Authenticator from supported applications, allowing you to quickly migrate existing codes without manually re-adding each one.
Google Authenticator (QR code): Import from Google Authenticator using a QR code... LastPass (JSON): Import a LastPass Authenticator account export... 2FAS (.2fas): Import a 2FAS backup file
